resources.string: The sensor forgets every phone, including this one. You will enter the code again.
The sensor remembers up to 3 phones and forgets the oldest. Clearing them also forgets this phone, so the next Bluetooth connection asks for the code again.
How a phone proves it is allowed to connect.
The sensor joins your Wi-Fi so this phone can sync without Bluetooth.
The same sync over your own Wi-Fi, found automatically and faster than Bluetooth. The Wi-Fi stream is not encrypted, so it carries only what the sensor would show on its screen.
Not on this network right now
The Wi-Fi token lets this phone sync over Wi-Fi. It is fetched over Bluetooth only, stored encrypted on this phone and never shown.
This phone can sync over Wi-Fi
This phone has no Wi-Fi token yet
Connect to the sensor and wait for its tasks to finish.
Sticker not saved. Check the link and try again.
The sensor did not confirm the sticker.
The PIN is still the default %1$s. Change it.
Fixed PIN. One 6 digit PIN you choose. For sensors without a screen.
New PIN (6 digits, leave empty to keep)
Pairing changes apply at the next restart, because Bluetooth security is set when the sensor starts.
No code. Still encrypted, but any phone nearby can pair without a prompt. For lab benches only.
Any phone nearby can pair without a code. Use this on a lab bench only.
Random code. A fresh 6 digit code on the sensor screen each time. It proves you are next to it.
Restart the sensor to apply the change.
The sensor saves its readings, restarts and reconnects. Pending pairing changes apply.
Every phone must get the new token over Bluetooth. Use this if a phone was lost.
This firmware reads Plantower PMS5003T sensors. Check the model printed on the fitted module before saving.

For this batch only, the estimate is %1$s times the count of particles above 0.3 µm per 0.1 L. It is an unvalidated manufacturer batch estimate, not a reference calibration. The raw reading stays available.
No reviewed batch factor for this sticker.
The sticker on the sensor differs from this phone’s record. Save it again.
Expected PMS5003T, a date (YYYYMMDD) and 1 to 9 unit digits.
Settings need newer firmware. Sync still works.
Could not join %1$s. Check the passphrase.
Changing Wi-Fi may drop this Wi-Fi link.
The passphrase travels over the encrypted Bluetooth link. The sensor stores it without encryption and never shows it again. Hidden networks are not listed.
stored on the device, never shown
The scan did not finish. Try again.
The sensor Wi-Fi radio cannot scan right now.
Finds your sensor on your Wi-Fi so syncing is faster. Bluetooth works without it.
Enter the sticker as PMS5003T, its date and unit digits.
Wait for the current sensor task to finish.
%1$s. Bluetooth changes apply after a restart.
Wi-Fi settings sent. The sensor is connecting.
The sensor forgot all paired phones. You pair again on the next Bluetooth connection.
The sensor refused %1$s. Nothing was changed.
Passwords and PINs go over Bluetooth only.
Not restarting while a sync runs. Stop the sync first.
The sensor refused to share its Wi-Fi token.
The sensor refused to share its settings.
The sensor refused the settings. Nothing was changed.
The sensor refused to change its token.
Could not get the Wi-Fi token. Try again.
Could not read the sensor settings. Try again.
Could not save the settings. Try again.
Could not restart the sensor. Try again.
Could not change the token. Try again.
Wi-Fi token stored on this phone.
Token changed and the new one stored on this phone.
Token changed. Use Fetch token to store the new one.
The network name is too long. The limit is 32 bytes.
The password is too long. The limit is 63 bytes.
Line breaks are not allowed here.
Connect to the sensor to read and change its settings.
Stand beside the sensor before using phone location. The phone converts the approximate fix to the chosen H3 cell. Only that cell is saved on the device. This does not enable uploads.
This firmware does not support location setup
Location setup failed. Reconnect and refresh to retry.
Device location was not confirmed. Refresh before retrying.
Use approximate phone location to choose a cell for this sensor
Allow approximate location in Settings to choose a sensor cell
Use phone location while standing beside the sensor
Lower resolution covers a larger area. Resolution 5 covers about 253 km² on average. Phone location is approximate.
Fine cells can reveal a specific place. A small cell does not make the phone fix more accurate. Public sharing has a separate resolution limit.
Optional ISO country code declared by you, such as EG. It does not guarantee NTP server residency.
Use phone location again before saving a finer cell
No fresh location available. Check location access and try again.
